summary: Loads the saved recipe-v3 result for a run, and says whether the editable scene deck was also built.
purpose: Gives the rest of the app one reliable way to read the finished v3 result.
why: The doc comment says it reads the deck_model stage and returns nothing for legacy or unfinished runs. The reason for the scene deck check is not stated; a likely reason is that the viewer needs to know whether the editable deck exists.
how: Reads the deck_model stage record for the run. Returns nothing if that stage has not succeeded or the stored result is not from the recipe-v3 engine. Then reads the scene_deck stage status and returns the result with a flag set to true only if that stage succeeded.
outputs: A RecipeV3Result object with the hasSceneDeck flag, or nothing.
risks: A missing run and an unfinished run both return nothing, so callers cannot tell them apart. Renaming a stage breaks the lookup silently.
debug: If a finished run returns nothing, check the deck_model stage status and the engine value in its saved summary. If hasSceneDeck is false, check the scene_deck stage status.
